method.rule: No inference is presented as the Rebbe's words. Corpus-level metadata verification does not imply item-level verification.

corpora.title: אגרות קודש
corpora.verified_metadata: Public Chabad.org series page describes Igrot Kodesh as a chronologically arranged collection of the Rebbe's letters and gives series-level scope information.
corpora.notes: Item-level verification requires exact letter pages or authoritative textual witnesses; preserve edition apparatus and witness status.

corpora.title: תורת מנחם – התוועדויות
corpora.verified_metadata: Chabad.org identifies the series as including maamarim, public talks and public letters; publisher identified as Vaad Hanachos B'Lahak.

corpora.title: לקוטי שיחות
corpora.verified_metadata: Public Chabad.org series page describes Likkutei Sichos as edited talks reviewed by the Rebbe and published over the years.
corpora.notes: Publisher/editorial indexes must remain distinct from research taxonomy.

corpora.title: רשימות
corpora.verified_metadata: Chabad.org exposes a dedicated Reshimos series page with booklet-level navigation and publisher metadata.
corpora.notes: Item-level entries should retain booklet identity and edition/witness distinctions.

corpora.title: ספר המאמרים מלוקט
corpora.verified_metadata: Chabad.org describes the series as maamarim edited/reviewed by the Rebbe and published in individual booklets; publisher identified as Vaad Hanachos B'Lahak.
corpora.notes: Textual status such as מוגה/הנחה/בלתי מוגה must be retained at item level where stated.

corpora.title: JEM / The Living Archive
corpora.verified_metadata: JEM describes The Living Archive as an effort to restore, preserve and provide access to video, audio and photo archives of the Rebbe.
corpora.notes: Recording Witness must be modeled separately for each recording; access and reuse rights must be checked per item.

corpora.title: ספריית אגודת חסידי חב״ד
corpora.notes: Archive holdings are not treated as item-level indexed without direct item access.

corpora.title: Igros Kodesh — The English Letters
corpora.verified_metadata: On 17 June 2026 Chabad.org reported Kehot's announcement of a new series prepared by Sichos in English to publish the Rebbe's English-language correspondence, anticipated at more than 10,000 letters across about 50 volumes and sometimes including recipient replies and related documents.
corpora.notes: Major future response-case corpus; full archive access is not assumed.

corpora.title: אגרות קודש — שכבת סריקות מהדורות דפוס
corpora.verified_metadata: Independent library indexes publicly point to HebrewBooks scans for many printed Igrot Kodesh volumes. This layer is recorded as a candidate printed-edition witness source, not yet as an item-level verified corpus.
corpora.notes: Strategically useful for checking page-level citations against printed editions. Exact HebrewBooks book IDs must be resolved volume by volume before promotion to Indexed.

corpora.title: Torah Recordings — אגרות קודש audio/text navigation
corpora.verified_metadata: Public Torah Recordings directories expose Igrot Kodesh navigation by volume, month and letter-number ranges; examples located include volumes 3, 6 and 12. The site labels its audio separately and attributes Hebrew text to WikiSource.
corpora.notes: Derivative discovery/cross-check layer only. Do not treat as primary witness; use to locate letter numbers and then verify against authoritative/printed witnesses.

corpora.title: מכון הלכה ברורה — קטלוג אגרות קודש
corpora.verified_metadata: The public virtual-library catalog enumerates Igrot Kodesh volumes of Rabbi Menachem Mendel Schneerson with volume/year bibliographic data and indicates links for volumes 1–22, while separately listing later volumes and translated editions. Search retrieval confirmed the catalog entry; individual linked scan endpoints remain unresolved here.
corpora.notes: Discovery and bibliographic cross-check only; not a primary textual witness. Useful for resolving printed-volume coverage and possible scan routes. Do not infer HebrewBooks IDs from catalog presence.
